message:
I recently stumbled upon a wonderful resource that got me thinking about how we can turn preparedness into a cozy family event. It’s all about learning safety skills together, and there’s something quite comforting in that. Whether it's teaching the grandkids how to stay safe during storms or practicing basic first aid, these moments can bring us closer and create lasting memories. 

I find that when we approach these topics with warmth and curiosity, it becomes less about fear and more about building confidence. Have you ever made a fun family project out of safety skills?
